note: resstd integration table (road kit, 17 Nov). Grid frame (u along 10th St toward ESE = layout x, v along Amber toward SSW = layout z, origin Amber x 10th). Place a piece at [u, y, v] with the yaw (Godot: yaw 90 turns the piece's +z to +x). Junctions: y = the grading pad. Legs: placed at the junction they start from (y = that pad), running along +z from z0 to z1; fillers are placed at a locked sample's junction. prof_a: the block's height profile from end A, [p0, p1, h] = h * smoothstep over p0..p1 metres from A's centre, relative to pad A.
assumptions: Legs from an Amber junction (amber family) start at 23.5 m, the side-street tile edge of j_amber_10th / j_cc, with the side street's section there (res: kerb 5.7, parkway to 7.2, walk to 9.2; hs: walk to 9.7; cc: kerb 3.3, walk to 9.7). If the amber family chose another tile edge, change z0 in the piece's SPEC and rebuild.

Legs from an arterial junction (art family: 3rd / 4th St, strip) start at 26 m, the side-street tile edge of j_strip, with the res / std section (kerb 5.7, parkway to 7.2, walk to 9.2), no centre line on res legs, a centre line on std legs.
Alley mouths: 54-60 m from our and the arterial junctions (apt_lib quadrant pattern), 44-50 m from Amber (pilot / centre pattern); block builders put their alleys there.
